bounded_text: 10-2000 chars enforced server-side; client maxlength/minlength only mirror
raw body > 8 KiB -> 413; non-JSON content-type -> 415; malformed JSON -> 400
no rows written for any rejected request
optional_verified_identity: base 9392cdd has no server-side verified session module (W3 feat/wa-first not yet in RC) -> contact field is optional and UNVERIFIED
upgrade path without schema change: route fills phone from server session and ignores client-supplied contact
server_validation: validateFeedbackPayload(): length, token shape, contact shape; UI is a mirror only
negatives: too short, too long, whitespace-only, missing token, malformed token, nonsense phone -> 400
rate_limit_anti_abuse: per IP 15 requests then 429 with Retry-After
in-process only (honest limit, not a multi-instance guard) — recorded in report SS7 item 5
xss_safe_rendering: <script>alert('xss')</script> stored as TEXT byte-for-byte, absent from the HTTP response body
201 returns {ok:true} with no echo of the payload; success screen is static text; {message} appears only as value=
no dangerouslySetInnerHTML in the shipped page
no_key_in_client: every JS chunk referenced by the page fetched and grepped: no service-role key present
route is the only writer; browser never talks to the DB
no_feedback_list_exposure: no read path in app code; anon reads 0 rows even with default Supabase grants (see harness grant migration 005)
no_raw_phone_or_token_logs: test phone numbers and request tokens absent from server logs
success logs only '[Feedback] stored id=... duplicate=...'
idempotent_retry_safe_insert: same request_token twice -> 201 twice but exactly 1 row
different text with the same token does not overwrite the stored row
generic_error_and_commit_before_success: unreachable DB -> 503, body carries no success marker, zero rows
missing Supabase config -> 503 fail-closed, no disk fallback that could fake success
link_target_prepared_for_b2: no change to Nina production; page is additive under /companion/nina/kritiksaran and outbound is disabled
ui_keyboard_mobile: SSR markup: label bound to #message, aria-describedby, role=alert, aria-live, inputMode, autoComplete, maxlength=2000/minlength=10, type=submit (Enter submits), visible focus ring, robots noindex
limit: verified as markup + HTTP flow, not simulated taps (no headless browser in the harness)

no read of production .env/logs/customer DB/production credentials; only local dummy rows
